channels.title: Arthur Revives the Past
channels.description:
History isn't dead, it's just waiting to be told.

Welcome to Arthur Revives the Past, the place where history stops being about dry dates and starts becoming a living experience. My mission is to rescue the most fascinating events in human history and breathe life back into them.

I don't just tell you what happened; I show you. By combining deep historical research with cutting-edge Artificial Intelligence, I recreate faces, landscapes, and legendary moments with stunning realism.

On this channel, you will find:

Epic Tales: Immersive narratives about empires, heroes, and forgotten legends.

AI-Powered Recreations: Breathtaking visuals that transport you directly into the ancient world.

Mysteries of Antiquity: Deep dives into the events that shaped human civilization.

History isn't dead—it was just waiting for the right technology to wake up. Subscribe and join me as we bring the past back to life.

channels.title: PastWalks
channels.description: Using AI and careful historical research, PastWalks brings you immersive walks through lost streets and forgotten cities, from Los Angeles to New York. Dedicated to accuracy and authenticity, we recreate the textures of everyday life with beauty, wonder, and realism, so you can experience our shared history step by step.

channels.title: The Unseen Past
channels.description:
THE UNSEEN PAST is a cinematic time travel vlog channel featuring Clara, our time-traveling host.

Experience the past through immersive AI historical reconstructions and first-person historical vlogs—from ancient cities and royal courts to pirate harbors and the streets of more recent decades.

Travel through Pompeii, imperial China, Versailles and 1950s America. Expect everyday discoveries, human encounters, humor and, on some journeys, a darker turn.

Our videos combine historical research with cinematic storytelling. Clara’s time-travel adventures, conversations and encounters are fictional dramatizations, with visuals created using AI.

Subscribe and step inside the unseen past.
